*Full-Stack Systems Engineer building production-grade Python infrastructures, Next.js dashboards, and event-driven automation architectures.*


Systems Engineering · Indore, India

# ENGINEERINGSCALABLE SYSTEMS

Aryan Sharma, a Full-Stack Systems Engineer specializing in production-grade Python infrastructures, custom data pipelines, and event-driven automation architectures. Building the robust backend services and clean Next.js interfaces that drive core business logic.

Core Focus

## Designing systems that run reliably, quietly, and forever.

[View Projects →](#work)

Infrastructure05 · Systems

### Event-driven pipelines that survive failure.

Robust implementation incorporating microservices, clean data schemas, and high-performance execution.

Media04 · Julius

### FFmpeg render DAGs at industrial scale.

Robust implementation incorporating microservices, clean data schemas, and high-performance execution.

AI03 · July

### Deterministic creative from unstructured intent.

Robust implementation incorporating microservices, clean data schemas, and high-performance execution.

Automation02 · Ops

### CRM workflows that pay for themselves in a week.

Robust implementation incorporating microservices, clean data schemas, and high-performance execution.

[Image: Aryan Sharma]

Systems Architecture

Philosophy

> "Great systems aren't loud. They compound quietly: reliable data layers, automated workers, and clean interfaces that solve problems without creating new ones. My role is to architect the solid engineering pipelines that keep operations running smoothly behind the scenes."

Aryan SharmaFull-Stack Systems Engineer

Case Studies

## Core Production Work.

[Image: Julius]

CASE 01

Media Processing System

### Julius

Built an industry-grade automated media processing pipeline for high-volume video workflows. Collapsed end-to-end runtime from 30 minutes to under 5 minutes through parallelizing rendering tasks and using Redis-backed queue workers.

### Media & Applied AI

Journey

## Professional History

### Full-Stack Engineer

Maa Pitambara Automobiles·Remote Freelance

05/2026 - Present

* ■Maintained and expanded the dealership's web platform, implementing CRM integrations and real-time inventory synchronization.
* ■Built CRM automation scripts for customer inquiries, SMS/email notifications, and lead tracking workflows.
* ■Implemented Redis and PostgreSQL-backed background services to keep lead generation and booking status in sync across internal systems.

### Full Stack Engineer

Kanchan Welfare Organisation·Remote Freelance

06/2024 - Present

* ■Led the NGO's digital transformation by building a secure Next.js portal and PostgreSQL database for volunteer, donor, and beneficiary administration.
* ■Developed automated reporting and record management workflows that streamlined processes and cut administrative effort by roughly 40%.
* ■Trained staff on using secure data management practices, digital database workflows, and portal systems.

### Full-Stack Engineer

Creativefuel·Indore, India

10/2025 - 04/2026

* ■Developed production-grade Python backend microservices and asynchronous worker nodes using REST APIs, Redis queues, and PostgreSQL state tracking.
* ■Built job recovery mechanisms for large-scale asset downloading, transcription, and audio-video rendering workflows.
* ■Developed internal Next.js dashboards to monitor real-time processing tasks, review model outputs, and control workflows.
* ■Designed FFmpeg-based media processing pipelines for automated video rendering, caption layouts, and export validations.

### Social Media Executive

Creativefuel·Remote Freelance

08/2025 - 09/2025

* ■Supervised content distribution operations across high-visibility digital properties with a combined audience of 1M+ followers.
* ■Identified repetitive content operations and proposed automation workflows that later informed internal tooling development.

### Full-Stack Engineer

Maa Pitambara Automobiles·Remote Freelance

10/2024 - 08/2025

* ■Designed and launched the dealership's first modern web platform to digitize vehicle inventory and client interactions.
* ■Designed relational database schemas for inventory management, scheduling, and customer records.
* ■Built automation scripts to synchronize external distributor inventory with the local dealership platform.

Academic

## Education & Research

### Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence

Medi-Caps University

India

2021 - 2025

**Coursework:** Automated architectures, relational database management, and full-stack systems engineering.

**Published Research:** Co-authored *"Immersive Meditation Experience Using Virtual Reality and Binaural Beats"*, published in the **IJAECS** (Vol. 12, Issue 7, Jul 2025).

Verifications

## Certifications & Athletics

### Full Stack Software Developer Professional Certificate

IBM • Coursera Verified

Rigorous 10-course credential validating advanced competencies in Python backend, cloud-native deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, React, and CI/CD pipelines.

[Verify on Credly ↗](https://www.credly.com)

#### Athletic Milestones

* ✓Captain of School Basketball team, led team to inter convent state level victory
* ✓District Level Football player
* ✓National Level Gymnastics player in early childhood
